## Bisso Galeto (CR 5)

The body and head of this creature resemble a large rooster with a big red comb, but its wings sport long spikes and its tail is long and snakelike.  

**XP** 1,600  
N Small magical beast  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +13; **Aura** pollution (30 ft.)  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 52 (7d10+14)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +6, **Will** +5  
**Immune** petrification, poison  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 20 ft. (clumsy)  
**Melee** bite +9 (1d4-2 plus poison), 2 wing buffets +4 (1d3-2 +1d4 piercing)  
**Special Attacks** lethal gaze, wing spikes  


**Statistics**


**Str** 8, **Dex** 13, **Con** 15, **Int** 2, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 16  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Fly -1, Perception +13  


**Special Abilities**



**Lethal Gaze (Su)** A bisso galeto can kill with its gaze three times per day, directing its deadly glare at a creature within 30 feet it can see. The target is frightened for 1d6 rounds (DC 15 Will negates) and must make an additional DC 15 Fortitude at the end of its next turn (unless the frightened condition is removed) or die of fright. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; save Fort DC 15; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Con; cure 2 consecutive saves.  

**Pollution Aura (Su)** Water becomes polluted around a bisso galeto, and plants die. This works as the blight and pollute water witch hexes (Fort DC 15 negates), except it has no effect on animals and creatures.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate plains and woods  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** none
